# CLOSING MECHANICS & BRING-DOWN DILIGENCE
## M&A Transaction — Lead Partner Decision Memo

**Date:** October 3, 2026
**Classification:** CONFIDENTIAL — DEAL TEAM ONLY
**Prepared by:** Lead M&A Partner
**Purpose:** Closing checklist; consents & funds flow finalization; bring-down reps/covenants

---

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

This memo governs the final mechanics of the transaction close. It covers (1) the master closing checklist with ownership and sequencing, (2) required third-party and governmental consents, (3) funds flow and wire coordination, and (4) bring-down diligence confirming that representations and covenants remain materially accurate as of the Closing Date. All parties must confirm sign-off on their respective workstreams by **5:00 PM local time, one business day prior to the scheduled Closing Date**.

### 3.3 Wire Authentication Protocol (Anti-Fraud)

1. **Wire Instruction Lock-Down:** All wire instructions must be confirmed **three (3) business days** before Closing by verified, encrypted email from Deal Counsel and co-signed by Target CFO. No modifications to wire instructions will be accepted within 48 hours of Closing without dual authorization (Lead Partner + CFO).
2. **Callback Authentication:** Treasury must conduct voice-call verification to a pre-registered phone number on file for each receiving bank, independently of email instructions.
3. **Wire Fraud Attestation:** Deal team members certify no suspicious communications (unexpected wire changes, new account requests) were received. Any anomaly triggers an immediate hold and escalation to Lead Partner.
4. **Same-Day Confirmation:** Treasury confirms receipt with each receiving institution before close of business on Closing Date.

## SECTION 4 — BRING-DOWN DILIGENCE

### 4.1 Purpose and Legal Standard

Bring-down diligence confirms that, as of the Closing Date, the representations and warranties made in the Purchase Agreement remain true and correct (subject to the materiality and MAE qualifiers in the SPA bring-down condition, typically Article [X], Section [X.X]). It also confirms that all covenants required to be performed prior to or at Closing have been satisfied.

**Applicable Standard (from SPA):** Representations and warranties must be true and correct as of the Closing Date as though made on the Closing Date (except those expressly made as of a specified date, which must be true and correct as of such specified date), except where the failure to be true and correct would not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect.

| Pending Litigation / Regulatory Actions | ☐ None New ☐ New Matter | [Evaluate whether new matter exceeds MAE threshold] |
| Loss of Material Customer or Contract | ☐ None ☐ Identified | [Assess materiality; revenue impact; MAE threshold] |

| Changes in Law / Regulation | ☐ None Material ☐ Change | [Note: Generally carved out of MAE definition] |

## SECTION 8 — DECISION MEMO

**Summary of Close-Readiness as of October 3, 2026:**

All workstreams are tracking to schedule. The deal team has been instructed to complete each checklist item with confirmed status by T-1 Business Day. Any open item classified as Severity 1 (Critical) in the Risk Flags log (Section 6) must be resolved or receive a written waiver from the Acquirer prior to wire authorization. The bring-down diligence framework is complete and the Target's CEO and CFO have been briefed on the bring-down certificate requirements. Funds flow has been circulated to banking counsel for final review. No MAC/MAE condition has been identified as of the date of this memo.

**Recommended Action:** Proceed to closing subject to satisfaction of all open items in this checklist and receipt of all outstanding consents. Reconvene Lead Partner authorization call at T-1 Business Day.
